Chloe — available Mon May 31 10:00–11:00 PDT (yes to the 13:00 EDT slot).

I've attached our standard priv-host runbook template and the CSV of ports we validate. For Alex's egress question: we'll cover three patterns briefly during the call —

1) Zero egress: model serving runs in a fully isolated network with private endpoints for control plane access over a managed peering link. We'll explain the tradeoffs and monitoring hooks.
2) Restricted egress: outbound only to documented Redwood control endpoints and image registries via a NAT gateway with strict firewall rules.
3) Audit + fallbacks: how we present audit logs and run fallback routing to a hosted model cluster for burst capacity (if customer allows limited egress).

Suggested structure: 60 mins total — 20 mins topology & constraints, 20 mins runbook / preflight checks, 20 mins Q&A + next steps. Attendees from our side: me (infra architect), David (deployment lead), and I recommend we also bring one ops engineer if available.

Attachments: privhost-runbook-template.pdf, network-ports.csv

-Karthik
